name: Example Team
purpose: A demo team: one member, one skill, one workflow, so you can see how every team is built. It shows you around and adds real teams from the library.

seats.name: Example Member
seats.detail: A demo team member: it shows the owner what's in their department and adds real teams from the library when they ask. It never changes `business.md`, anything in `brand/`, or a team that's already in `departments/`.

skills.name: show-me-around
skills.owns: Say "show me around". Your first day, or any time you want to see what's here and what you can add next.
